method: python zipfile local read of raw bytes; header line excluded; trailer lines parsed separately
schema_row: SETTLEMENT DATE|CUSIP|SYMBOL|QUANTITY (FAILS)|DESCRIPTION|PRICE (6 pipe columns, identical across all measured files incl. quarterly member class per SNG6)
trailer_guard: EACH file carries TWO trailer rows: 'Trailer record count N' and 'Trailer total quantity of shares M'; BOTH reconcile exactly (N=data rows; M=raw sum=deduped (settlement,cusip) sum; zero duplicate keys measured). Trailer rows MUST be excluded by parsers.
sng6_row_count_reconciliation: SNG6-A3 'row_counts' (e.g. 57539 for 200907a) = data rows + 2 trailer lines (57537+2); this audit counts data rows = trailer-declared record count. No contradiction.
stock_semantics: same CUSIP repeats across multiple settlement dates within one file with changing QUANTITY (e.g. FRC 33616C100 daily rows Apr-May 2023) -> per-settlement-date net-balance STOCK series, not a flow; PRICE '.' = 0.62-6.12 pct of rows per file (page: '.' when unavailable or < one penny); PRICE = prior-day close per archived page text
quarterly_series: cnsp_sec_fails_2004q1..2009q2 (22 zips); page: pre-2008-09-16 rows only balances >= 10,000 shares (splice flag mandatory)
